blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.
blocks.zh: 从EEG解码视觉信息是脑-计算机接口和脑启发智能的核心,与被预先训练的视觉基础模型(VFMs)的对比一致已经成为了主导范式. 然而,现有方法仅将EEG与CLIP-family VFM相配合,使得神经反应中的分级视觉信息开发不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们制定了一种机制-paradigm函证视图,将分级视觉处理(从外观到语义)与跨paradigm VFM的互补偏差联系起来,只图像模型(例如:DINO)和图像-文本模型(例如:CLIP)能够捕捉这种分级的不同方面. 在这一观点的指导下,我们提出了双师级校对框架。 具体来说,一个共享的EEG编码器由被冷冻的多蓝CLIP和浅的DINOv2教师通过双分支对比对接来监督,因此每个分支都完全监督它所强调到的视觉提示. 一个引信-检索目标学习适应性分量来结合它们互补的视觉表现来进行零镜头的EEG到图像回取. 对于共享的 EEG 编码器,我们引入了Attentive Moduated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder(AMSPBE),将节奏-空间注意力与可学习的头皮-平面库结合起来,用于准确,可解释的视觉特征提取,同时模拟区域时间动态和滤波-银行地貌. 在 MOTIONS-EEG 零发取回上, DTHA 实现了92.4% Top-1 的精度, 超过 12. 4% 。 空间、光谱和代表性 -- -- 相似性分析,以及MOTIS-MEG评价,验证了DTHA的有效性、生物可信性和跨模式通用性。 这种由互补驱动的视角表明,通过跨参数VFM进行监管,可以更完整地从大脑活性中提取层次视觉信息.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Visual neural decoding aims to extract visual information from brain activity, serving as a bridge between human cognition and artificial intelligence while deepening our understanding of the human visual mechanism and advancing brain-inspired intelligence.
Among non-invasive neuroimaging modalities, electroencephalography (EEG) offers high temporal resolution and portability, and has drawn increasing attention for brain–computer interface (BCI) applications [ 1 , 2 ] .
However, the complexity of human visual processing and the relatively low signal-to-noise ratio of scalp EEG pose significant challenges for EEG-based visual decoding.
Recent large-scale and diverse datasets acquired under rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) paradigms have provided a strong empirical foundation for this research line [ 2 , 3 ] .
On these benchmarks, zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval has become a standard evaluation task for visual decoding, with retrieval accuracy reflecting decoding performance from scalp EEG.
blocks.zh:
视觉神经解码旨在从大脑活性中提取视觉信息,作为人类认知和人工智能之间的桥梁,同时加深我们对人类视觉机制的理解并推进脑启发智能.
在非侵入神经成像模式中,电脑学(EEG)提供了高时间分辨率和可移植性,并引起人们日益关注大脑-计算机接口应用[1,2].
然而,人类视觉处理的复杂性和头皮EEG相对较低的信号-噪声比,对基于EEG的视觉解码提出了重大挑战.
近期在快速序列可视化(RSVP)范式下获得的大规模和多样化数据集为本研究线[2,3]提供了坚实的经验基础.
在这些基准上,零镜头的EEG到图像检索成为了可视化解码的标准评价任务,其检索精度反映了头皮EEG的解码性能.

blocks.en:
The prevailing paradigm for EEG-based visual decoding is contrastive learning, which aligns EEG with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) in a shared embedding space to extract visual information from EEG [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
This paradigm has driven rapid progress, yet most methods under it align EEG only with CLIP-family VFMs.
CLIP supervision recovers category-level semantics effectively, but under-extracts appearance-related structure that is also encoded in EEG.
blocks.zh:
以EEG为基础的视觉解码的主要范式是对比性学习,它将EEG与预先训练的视觉基础模型(VFMs)在共享嵌入空间相配合,从EEG中取出视觉信息[4,5,6,7].
这种范式推动了快速进步,然而它下的大多数方法只将EEG与CLIP-family VFM相配合.
CLIP监理能有效恢复类别层次的语义,但取而代之的是同样被编码为EEG的外观相关结构.

blocks.en:
Decades of neuroscience research have established that human vision is organized hierarchically rather than as a single representational stage [ 8 , 9 ] .
As illustrated in Fig. 1 (top), this hierarchy extends from appearance-related structure toward semantic understanding of visual content [ 10 ] .
In computer vision, modern VFMs are trained under distinct paradigms (Fig. 1 , bottom). Image-only self-supervised learning (e.g., DINO) learns structure from visual data without language supervision [ 11 , 12 ] , whereas image–text contrastive learning (e.g., CLIP) aligns visual embeddings with natural-language descriptions [ 13 ] .
Driven by scale in data and model capacity, modern VFMs exhibit an emergence of paradigm-differentiated visual capabilities that parallel human vision: for example, DINO develops dense patch-level descriptors that preserve appearance-related structure, whereas CLIP learns transferable image–text representations that support semantic categorization.
Recent brain–model studies of DINOv3 further suggest that its representations can functionally relate to the human visual mechanism [ 14 ] .
Integrating these observations, we formulate a mechanism–paradigm correspondence view that links hierarchical visual processing to VFMs trained under distinct paradigms for brain–image alignment.
blocks.zh:
数十年的神经科学研究已经确定,人类的视觉是按等级排列的,而不是作为一个单一的代表阶段[8,9].
如图1(上)所示,这种等级从与外观有关的结构延伸到对视觉内容的语义理解[10].
在计算机视觉中,现代VFM在不同的范式(图1,下方)下进行训练. 仅由图像自我监督的学习(如:DINO)从视觉数据中学习结构而无需语言监督[11,12],而图像-文本对比性学习(如:CLIP)将视觉嵌入与自然语言描述相协调[13].
在数据和模型能力的驱动下,现代VFM呈现出一种与人类视觉平行的范式差异视觉能力的出现:例如,DINO开发出密集的补丁级描述符来保存外观相关结构,而CLIP学习可转移的图像-文本表达符支持语义分类.
最近对DINOv3的大脑-模型研究还进一步表明,其表达可以与人类视觉机制[14]在功能上相关.
整合这些观察,我们形成一种机制-paradigm函证观点,将等级视觉处理与在大脑-图像对接的不同范式下训练的VFM联系起来.

blocks.en:
Guided by this view, we propose DTHA (Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment), a complementarity-driven dual-teacher alignment framework.
Concretely, a shared encoder learns an EEG embedding that is contrastively aligned to frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers through dual-branch supervision, so that each teacher can fully supervise the visual cues it emphasizes.
Complementing these branch objectives, a fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive fusion weights during training to merge branch-wise brain–image similarities into a joint ranking score, so that semantic and appearance-related cues jointly drive zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval.
We further introduce AMSPBE (Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder), which applies temporo-spatial attention modulation and a learnable scalp-pattern bank for more accurate and interpretable EEG feature extraction, including regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies.
We also conduct spatial, spectral, and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to assess the biological plausibility of our dual-teacher framework.
blocks.zh:
以这一观点为指导,我们提出DTHA(双师级对接),这是一个互补驱动的双师级对接框架.
具体地说,一个共享编码器通过双分支的监管来学习一个EEG嵌入式的EEG,与被冷冻的多块CLIP和浅的DINOv2教师相对应,这样每个教师就可以完全监督它所强调视觉提示.
为了补充这些分支目标,一个引信检索目标在培训期间学习适应性聚变分量,将分支智能脑-图像相似性合并为联合排名分数,从而使语义和外观相关的提示能共同驱动零镜头的EEG对图像检索.
我们还引进了AMPBE(加速模版Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder),该机采用了节奏-空间注意力调制和可学习的头皮-模版库,用于更准确和可解释的EEG特征提取,包括区域时间动态和滤波-银行地貌.
我们还进行空间、光谱和代表性相似性分析,以评估我们双重教师框架的生物学可信性。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: 1. To our knowledge, we are the first to formulate a mechanism–paradigm correspondence view between hierarchical human visual processing and cross-paradigm VFMs, and to apply it toward more complete extraction of visual information from EEG. 2. We propose DTHA (Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment), a complementarity-driven dual-teacher framework that enables full exploitation of each teacher branch and effective fusion of their complementary visual cues. We further propose AMSPBE (Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder) for accurate and interpretable extraction of visual features from EEG. 3. Through extensive experiments and analyses, we validate the rationale, effectiveness, and cross-modality generalization of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art zero-shot retrieval on standard EEG and MEG benchmarks. Spatial, spectral, and representational analyses further support the biological plausibility of complementarity-driven dual-teacher alignment and provide new insights into visual neural decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 据我们所知,我们首先在人类的视觉处理和跨视觉的VFM之间形成一种机制-paradigm对应观点,并将其应用于更全面地从EEG中提取视觉信息。 2. 我们提议 " 双师级对接 " ,这是一个相辅相成的双师制框架,能够充分利用每个师资部门,有效地融合其互补的视觉提示。 我们进一步提出AMSPBE(Attentive Modued Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder),以准确和可解释地从EEG中取出视觉特征. 3. 通过广泛的实验和分析,我们验证了我们方法的基本原理、有效性和跨模式通用性,从而实现标准教育、科学和技术基准的最新零镜头检索。 空间、光谱和表现分析进一步支持了互补驱动的双教师对齐的生物学可信性,并对视觉神经分解提供了新的见解。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A EEG Visual Decoding
blocks.zh: II-A EG 视觉解码

blocks.en:
Visual neural decoding aims to interpret brain activity to retrieve, recognize, or reconstruct visual stimuli.
While early efforts often relied on fMRI for its high spatial resolution [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] , electroencephalography (EEG) has gained increasing attention for its high temporal resolution, non-invasive acquisition, and portability in brain–computer interface (BCI) applications.
Following early deep-learning evidence that object-evoked EEG can support visual classification [ 1 ] , large-scale RSVP benchmarks such as THINGS-EEG [ 2 ] and frameworks like BraVL [ 20 ] and NICE [ 4 ] established zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval as a central research setting.
Contrastive alignment with frozen CLIP-family VFMs is now the dominant paradigm on these benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
视觉神经解码旨在解释大脑活性以取回,识别,或重建视觉刺激.
虽然早期的努力往往依靠fMRI进行高空间分辨[15,16,17,18,19],但电脑学(EEG)因其高时间分辨度,非入侵性获取,以及大脑-计算机接口(BCI)应用中的可移植性而越来越受关注.
在早期深入学习的证据表明被物体取出EEG可以支持视觉分级[1]后,大规模RSVP基准,如MthingS-EEG[2],以及BravL[20]和NICE[4]等框架,将零射入EEG-到图像检索作为中心研究设置.
与被冻结的CLIP-家族VFM相矛盾的配合,现在是这些基准的主要范例.

blocks.en:
Recent methods improve decoding along several directions, yet most still assemble supervision from CLIP-family or generative-visual teachers. Student-side encoding improves EEG representation learning, e.g., subject-aggregation and group-aware variants of NICE (NICE-SA/GA) [ 4 ] and ATM with a patch-based spatiotemporal-convolution encoder [ 5 ] . Alignment constraint reinforcement strengthens brain–image alignment with dedicated objectives, including VE-SDN [ 6 ] and MB2C [ 7 ] . Information enhancement incorporates auxiliary modalities, such as language-guided contrastive learning in NICE++ [ 21 ] and depth-aware supervision in CogCap [ 22 ] and CogCapPro [ 23 ] ; in each case, language descriptions or depth maps are still CLIP-family encoded for alignment. Teacher-side adaptation modifies how frozen CLIP features are presented to the brain branch, e.g., uncertainty-aware blur priors in UBP [ 24 ] , multi-blur CLIP fusion in LVBP [ 25 ] , visual prompt tuning in NeuroCLIP [ 26 ] , cognitive-prior augmentation in NeuroBridge [ 27 ] , multi-encoder fusion of CLIP and VAE features in HVF [ 28 ] , and adaptive CLIP feature shrinking in ATS (our prior work) [ 29 ] .
Although these advances have substantially improved retrieval performance, the underlying teacher-side supervision still favors category-level semantics and only limited appearance-related cues—whether from multi-blur CLIP inputs or VAE latents—and rarely employs cross-paradigm teacher pairing, leaving richer fine-grained structure in EEG under-exploited.
This gap motivates our mechanism–paradigm correspondence view and complementarity-driven cross-paradigm dual-teacher alignment (DTHA).
blocks.zh:
最近的方法改进了几个方向的解码,但大多数方法仍然由CLIP家庭或遗传-视觉教师进行监督。 学生侧编码改进了EEG代表学的学习,例如NICE(NICE-SA/GA)[4]和ATM的主体-集合和群体-意识变体,并带有以补丁为主的spatiopal-convolution编码器[5]. 对齐约束强化强化了大脑-图像与专门目标,包括VE-SDN[6]和MB2C[7]. 信息增强包含辅助模式,如NICE++ [21]中语言指导对比学习和CogCap [22]和CogCapPro [23]中深度感知监督;在每一种情况下,语言描述或深度地图仍然被编码为CLIP-family以对齐. 教师-侧适应改变如何向大脑分支呈现被冻结的CLIP特征,例如,UBP[24]中的不确定性-意识模糊的前科,LVBP[25]中的多蓝CLIP聚变,NeuroCLIP[26]中的视觉即时调谐,NeuroBridge中的认知-先增强[27],HVF[28]中的CLIP和VAE特征多编码聚变,以及ATS(我们以前的工作)中的适应性CLIP特征收缩[29].
虽然这些进展大大改善了检索性能,但基本的教师侧监督仍然倾向于类别层次的语义学,而只倾向于有限的外观相关提示——无论是从多块CLIP输入还是从VAE潜入——而且很少使用跨参数的教师配对,使得EEG中较丰富的精细结构没有得到充分利用。
这一差距促使我们的机制-paradigm函授观点和互补驱动的跨paradigm双教师组合(DTHA).

blocks.en: II-B Vision Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 二-B 展望基金会模式

blocks.en:
Visual foundation models (VFMs) are large-scale encoders pretrained on broad visual or multimodal data and reused across downstream vision tasks.
Although modern VFMs increasingly share transformer backbones trained on web-scale data, their behavior differs less by architectural family alone than by training paradigm .
blocks.zh:
视觉基础模型(VFM)是大型编码器,在广义视觉或多模式数据上预先训练,并跨下游视觉任务再用.
虽然现代的VFM越来越共享在网络尺度数据上训练的变压器骨干,

blocks.en:
We adopt a coarse two-way categorization of VFMs: image-only supervision and image–text alignment.
Within the image-only line, multi-view self-distillation (DINO, DINOv2, DINOv3 [ 30 ] ) learns invariances across augmented views and yields dense patch-level descriptors that emphasize appearance-related structure.
The image–text line aligns visual embeddings with language supervision (CLIP, PE-Core [ 31 ] ), favoring transferable semantic categorization.
As comparative analyses confirm [ 32 ] , distinct training paradigms systematically shape attention patterns, feature geometry, and downstream representational biases.
Aligning EEG to frozen MoCo-, MAE-, or SAM-pretrained VFMs remains promising but is outside the scope of this work.
blocks.zh:
我们采用粗糙的双向 VFM 分类: 仅图像监督 和图像 - 文本对齐 。
在只以图像为主的行中,多视图自沉(DINO, DINov2, DINov3 [30])通过拓宽的视图来学习偏差并产生密集的补丁平面描述符来强调外观相关结构.
图像-文本行将视觉嵌入与语言监督相协调(CLIP,PE-Core [31]),倾向于可转移语义分类.
比较分析证实[32],不同的培训范式系统地塑造了注意模式、地貌几何和下游代表性偏差。
将EEG与被冻结的MoCo-、MAE-或SAM-预先训练的VFM相统一,仍然是有希望的,但不属于这项工作的范围。

blocks.en: II-C Brain–Model Comparison Studies
blocks.zh: II-C 脑-模型比较研究

blocks.en:
Brain–model comparison studies, using encoding models and RSA among other methods, analyze the brain–model mapping between human visual responses and deep network representations [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] .
More recently, Raugel et al. [ 14 ] analyze DINOv3 in depth, examining how model scale, training duration, and data type shape alignment with human fMRI/MEG.
These studies are highly inspiring, yet they primarily analyze brain–model relationships rather than apply such insights to visual decoding, and the recent DINOv3 analysis remains within a single self-supervised paradigm.
In contrast, we formulate a mechanism–paradigm correspondence view that exploits complementary cross-paradigm VFMs for improved EEG visual decoding.

最近,Raugel等人[14]深入分析了DINOv3,研究了模型尺度、培训期限和数据类型如何与人类fMRI/MEG相匹配。

blocks.en: III-D Brain Encoder (AMSPBE)
blocks.zh: III-D 大脑编码器(AMPBE)

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , AMSPBE (Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder) is the brain encoder f B f_{B} , mapping RSVP-evoked EEG to a 1024 1024 -D brain embedding z b z_{b} for alignment with the dual-teacher framework.
blocks.zh: 如图3所显示,AMSPBE(Attentive Modued Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder)是大脑编码器f B f-QQB},将RSVP-evoked EEG映射到一个1024 1024-D-脑嵌入z b-z-Q-b}与双师框架相匹配.

blocks.en:
Under rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP), stimulus images are serially presented to subjects at a rapid rate, so temporally adjacent trials induce temporal aliasing [ 2 ] , leading to significant cross-stimulus interference that degrades single-trial EEG.
Furthermore, brain responses to visual stimuli reflect hierarchical visual processing across scalp regions, and different regions and time points contribute unequally to visual decoding.
Accordingly, we introduce temporo-spatial attention modulation (TSAM) through a coarse tri-region split of the electrode montage into posterior, central, and frontal channel sets: each region shares one learnable temporal attention curve, complemented by per-channel attention (Fig. 3 ).
All attention weights are initialized to one and learned end-to-end to upweight decoding-relevant channels and time points while suppressing aliasing-induced noise.

在快相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
此外,大脑对视觉刺激的反应反映了头皮各地区的分级视觉处理,不同地区和时间点对视觉解码的贡献不平等。
因此,我们通过一个粗糙的三区将电极相接器分割成后相接器、中央相接器和前相接器,引入了节奏-空间相接器(TSAM):每个区域共用一个可学习的时间相接器,并辅之以每个通道相接器(图3)。
所有注意力权重被初始化为一并被学习到的端到端到上重解码相关通道和时间点,同时抑制别名引起的噪音.

blocks.en:
After attention modulation and lightweight temporal encoding, visual decoding may rely on different collaborative channel combinations across the electrode montage rather than on any single electrode.
Following [ 25 ] , we adopt a learnable scalp-pattern filter bank ( K = 16 K{=}16 ) with positivity-constrained spatial convolutions, which learns multiple distinct combination patterns over the electrode layout, as illustrated by several representative scalp-pattern topographies in Fig. 3 .
These two components—temporo-spatial attention modulation with temporal encoding, and the scalp-pattern filter bank—jointly constitute AMSPBE.
Learned attention curves and filter-bank topographies are analyzed in Sec. IV-F .
blocks.zh:

继[25]之后,我们采用了可学习的头皮-平面滤波器库(K = 16 K{=}16),具有正向性受限制的空间回旋,在电极布局上学习出多种不同的组合模式,图3中几个有代表性的头皮-平面地形图说明了这一点。
这两种成分——用时间编码的时空空间注意调制和头皮型滤波库——共同构成AMPBE。
所学的注意曲线和滤波库地貌分析见Sec.IV-F.。

blocks.en: IV Experiments and Analysis
blocks.zh: 四. 试验和分析

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 数据集和预处理

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on THINGS-EEG [ 2 ] and THINGS-MEG [ 3 ] ; dataset scales and acquisition parameters are summarized in Table I .
THINGS-EEG provides the primary benchmark for all main results and analyses, while THINGS-MEG is used for cross-modality validation.
blocks.zh:
我们进行关于MthingS-EEG[2]和MthingS-MEG[3]的实验;数据集尺度和获取参数摘要见表一。
MthingS-EEG为所有主要结果和分析提供了主要基准,而MthingS-MEG用于跨模式验证.

blocks.en:
The EEG recordings come from ten participants who viewed images under a time-efficient RSVP paradigm.
The training split comprises 1654 1654 concepts × \times 10 10 images × \times 4 4 repetitions, and the test split comprises 200 200 concepts × \times 1 1 image × \times 80 80 repetitions.
The stimulus onset asynchrony (SOA) is 200 200 ms, consisting of a 100 100 ms image presentation followed by a 100 100 ms blank interval.
For preprocessing, we epoch trials from 0 0 to 1000 1000 ms after stimulus onset, downsample to 250 Hz ( T = 250 T{=}250 ), apply baseline correction, and average repetitions within each image to improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).
Following standard THINGS-EEG practice, multivariate noise normalization (MVNN) is applied at the subject level.
blocks.zh:
EEG的录音来自10名参与者,他们在时间效率高的RSVP范式下观看了图像.
训练分会包含1654个1654个概念 \times 10个图像 \times 4个4个重复,测试分会包含200个概念 \times 1 1个图像 \times 80个重复.
刺激启动同步(SOA)为200 200 ms,包括100 100 ms的图像演示,然后是100 100 ms的空白间隔。
为了进行预处理,我们在刺激发作后进行从0到1000千米的历时试验,将样本降低到250赫兹(T=250T{=}250),应用基线校正,在每个图像内进行平均重复来提高信号-噪声比(SNR).
按照标准的东西-EEG实践,多变量噪声常态(MVNN)应用在主题层面.

blocks.en:
The MEG benchmark includes four participants and 271 271 channels, with a longer stimulus duration ( 500 500 ms) and SOA of 1500 ± 200 1500{\pm}200 ms.
MEG trials are epoched over the same post-stimulus window, band-pass filtered, downsampled to 200 Hz ( T = 201 T{=}201 ), and MVNN-normalized; configuration and preprocessing follow a similar protocol [ 21 , 24 ] .
On MEG, the same f B f_{B} applies; tri-region channel indices are defined on the CTF-275 electrode montage.

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Brain Encoders

The default brain encoder is AMSPBE (Sec. III-D ; Fig. 3 ).
To validate the effectiveness of AMSPBE, we additionally replace it with TSConv [ 4 ] , SpatialConv [ 25 ] , EEGNet [ 38 ] , ShallowNet/DeepConvNet [ 39 ] , EEGProject [ 24 ] , and STAE [ 29 ] under the same dual-teacher training recipe (Sec. IV-F ).

Models are trained for 250 epochs with batch size 1024 on 8 NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs using AdamW ( lr = 10 − 3 \mathrm{lr}{=}10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) and a 10-epoch warmup cosine schedule.
Loss weights, temperature, and normalization follow Sec. III-B .
Following standard THINGS-EEG practice [ 4 , 25 ] , the official 200-concept test split is reserved for final evaluation only; for model selection and encoder hyperparameter tuning, we randomly hold out 5% of each subject’s training set as a validation split, as in LVBP [ 25 ] .
Main results in Tables II and III are averaged over seeds { 2025 , 42 , 1234 } \{2025,42,1234\} ; ablations use seed 2025 unless noted otherwise.

blocks.en: IV-C Cross-Paradigm Teacher Representational Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 教师代表分析

blocks.en: To assess our mechanism–paradigm correspondence view, we first examine whether cross-paradigm CLIP and DINO teachers provide differentiated supervision for EEG-based visual decoding, and how each should be configured to emphasize the visual cues its training paradigm best supports.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的机制-paradigm函授观点,我们首先审查跨paradigm CLIP和DINO的教师是否为基于EEG的视觉解码提供有区别的监督,以及应如何配置每个人,以强调视觉提示是其培训模式的最佳支持。

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Semantic vs. Appearance-Related Structure
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 语义与外观结构

blocks.en:
We define six top-down categories by aggregating THINGS manual metadata (food, animal, container, clothing, tool, and vehicle) and perform coarse-category representational similarity analysis (RSA) [ 33 ] on THINGS-EEG training images (494 concepts, one image per concept; Fig. 4 (A)).
CLIP-RN50 exhibits a clear block-diagonal pattern aligned with these categories, indicating that its representation space is organized by category-level concepts.
DINOv2 ViT-L/14, by contrast, shows much weaker category clustering and no comparable within-category structure.
This contrast supports differentiated cross-paradigm supervision roles—CLIP as a semantic teacher and DINO as an appearance-related teacher—rather than two redundant encoders with overlapping representational biases.
blocks.zh:
我们通过汇总MOTES手动元数据(食品、动物、容器、服装、工具和车辆),对MOTES-EEG培训图像(494个概念,每个概念一个图像;图4(A))。
CLIP-RN50显示了与这些类别一致的清晰的区块-对角图案,表明其代表空间是按照类别级概念排列的.
相形之下,DINOv2 VIT-L/14显示类别组别较弱,类别内结构无可比性。
这种对比支持不同的跨参数监督角色—— CLIP是一名语义教师,DINO是一名与外观有关的教师,而不是两个具有重叠代表性偏见的冗余编码器。

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Multi-Blur CLIP Supervision
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 多块CLIP 监督

blocks.en:
Following LVBP [ 25 ] , we adopt its multi-level blur on image inputs but interpret its role differently.
Fig. 4 (B) shows that block-diagonal category-semantic clustering weakens progressively as σ \sigma increases.
Fig. 4 (C) tracks this shift numerically by asking, at each blur level, whether CLIP groups images more by category semantics or by color similarity.
For each σ \sigma , we summarize pairwise image dissimilarities as representational dissimilarity matrices (RDMs; pairwise stimulus dissimilarities) in CLIP space and in two reference spaces—category-semantic proxies and Lab-chroma—and compute Spearman rank correlation ρ \rho between them over all image pairs; ρ \rho measures rank-order consistency between the CLIP and reference distance structures—higher ρ \rho means pairs that are more dissimilar under the reference also tend to be more dissimilar in CLIP space.
Fig. 4 (C) shows that stronger blur weakens category-semantic consistency while strengthening chroma consistency, yet category-semantic ρ \rho remains substantially higher.
Accordingly, multi-blur CLIP supplements this semantic branch with blur-induced appearance-related information.
blocks.zh:
在LVBP[25]之后,我们采用其在图像输入上的多层次模糊,但对其作用有不同的解释.
图4(B)显示,随着\sigma的增加,区块-对角类-语义组合逐渐减弱。
图4(C)通过询问CLIP是将图像按类语义或颜色相近,在每一个模糊的关卡,来跟踪这一转变的数字.
对于每个 & sigma, 我们总结成对图像的异同性, 作为CLIP空间和两个参考空间—— 类- 语义代词和 Lab- chroma —— 中的代表异同性矩阵( RDMs; 成对刺激异同性矩阵), 并计算Spearman 在所有图像配对上的对应性 ^\rho ; ^\rho 测量 CLIP 和 参考相距结构之间的等同性 – 更高 ^\rho 表示在CLIP 空间中比较相异的对 。
图4(C)显示,较强的模糊度会削弱类别语义一致性,同时加强染色体一致性,但类别语义 à\rho 仍然高得多。
因此,多蓝CLIP以模糊引起的外观相关信息来补充这个语义分支.

blocks.en: IV-C 3 Shallow DINO Supervision
blocks.zh: IV-C 3 浅地DINO监督

blocks.en:
Because multi-blur CLIP supplies only partial appearance-related cues on the semantic branch, we turn to DINO for richer structure-related supervision and examine which depth range best preserves appearance-related structure.
On THINGS-EEG test images ( n = 200 n{=}200 concepts), Fig. 5 compares Spearman ρ \rho with chroma and category-semantic proxies across CLIP, PE-Core, and multiple DINO variants by depth.
Chroma consistency peaks in shallow layers and weakens with depth, whereas category-semantic consistency grows in deeper layers; on most ViT teachers the semantic and chroma ρ \rho curves cross (gold dashed lines).
Fig. 6 adds six low-level visual proxies (chroma, luminance, edge density, and spectral statistics) to corroborate this depth trend: all show generally higher ρ \rho in shallow layers and weaken with depth, with layer 14 near the crossover.
Accordingly, we adopt shallow DINOv2 layers (L0–L14) as the appearance-related teacher.
blocks.zh:
由于多蓝CLIP只在语义分支上提供部分外观相关提示,我们转向DINO进行更丰富的结构相关监督,并检查哪个深度范围最能保存外观相关结构.

blocks.en: IV-D Vision Teacher Selection
blocks.zh: IV-D 愿景教师甄选

blocks.en:
From representational analyses in Sec. IV-C , we specify multi-blur CLIP as the semantic teacher and shallow DINO layers as the appearance-related teacher; we next validate each teacher through single-teacher retrieval sweeps.
With AMSPBE and all other training settings held constant, each sweep uses only the CLIP or DINO branch SCE loss (Eq. ( 2 )), without the fused-retrieval objective (Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh:

由于AMSPBE和所有其他训练设置保持不变,每次扫荡只使用CLIP或DINO分支SCE损失(Eq. (2)),没有引信-检索目标(图7.).

blocks.en: IV-D 1 CLIP Teachers and Multi-Blur
blocks.zh: CLIP 教师和多种语言

blocks.en:
As the top of Fig. 7 shows, CLIP-style teachers consistently outperform PE-Core on the semantic branch.
Multi-blur supervision exceeds sharp-only inputs ( σ = 1 \sigma{=}1 ) for both, consistent with Sec. IV-C : blur supplements appearance-related cues beyond sharp image–text features alone; RN50 multi-blur reaches the strongest branch Top-1 ( 79.7 % 79.7\% ).
We do not sweep CLIP architectures extensively; our prior ATS work [ 29 ] shows that overly strong vision teachers widen the brain–vision asymmetry, and RN50 offers the best trade-off among the teachers tested.
blocks.zh:

我们没有广泛搜索CLIP架构;我们之前的ATS工作[29]表明,过于强壮的视觉教师拓宽了大脑-视觉不对称,RN50为测试的教师提供了最好的取舍。

blocks.en: IV-D 2 DINO Teachers and Depth Span
blocks.zh: IV-D 2 DINO 教师和深度

blocks.en:
On the appearance-related branch, we compare DINOv2 and DINOv3 across architectures, scales, and layer spans.
DINOv2 ViT-L/14 yields the strongest single-teacher retrieval.
Although DINOv3 generally leads on vision benchmarks, matched-scale DINOv3 teachers underperform DINOv2 on EEG retrieval in this sweep.
DINOv3’s Gram anchoring [ 30 ] stabilizes dense patch features for geometric vision tasks, but the resulting patch-level features carry finer local visual structure than noisy scalp EEG can reliably encode; consistent with the brain–vision asymmetry in our prior ATS work [ 29 ] , this mismatch widens the modality gap and hurts retrieval.
For layer-span comparisons in Fig. 7 , we adopt a uniform mid-depth split (first vs. second half of blocks; solid vs. hatched bars); shallow spans generally outperform deep spans, corroborating Sec. IV-C .
Motivated by the crossover near layer 14 in Fig. 6 , we further test DINOv2 ViT-L/14 with L0–L14: it exceeds the half-depth shallow span (L0–L11), deep layers L15–L23, and full-depth fusion (L0–L23), while the final-layer CLS reaches only 20.4 % 20.4\% (Fig. 7 ).
This contrast further underscores why the layer-wise DINO analysis in Sec. IV-C is essential for EEG-based visual decoding, rather than conventionally adopting the final-layer CLS.
These sweeps establish our default pairing: CLIP RN50 multi-blur + DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (L0–L14).
blocks.zh:
在与外观相关的分支上,我们比较了DINov2和DINov3,跨越了建筑,尺度,和地层跨度.
DINOv2 VIT-L/14产生最强单师检索.
尽管DINOv3一般领先于视觉基准,但匹配规模的DINOv3教师在本次扫荡中未将DINOv2的EEG检索完成.
DINOv3的Gram锚定[30]稳定了几何视觉任务的密集补丁特征,但由此产生的补丁平面特征比吵闹的头皮EEG可以可靠地编码的局部视觉结构更细;与我们以前的ATS作品中的大脑-视觉不对称[29]一致,这种不匹配扩大了模式差距并伤害了检索。
关于图7中的分层-分层比较,我们采用统一的中深分法(第一至后半个区块;固体至孵化的栏杆);浅分跨度一般大于深分跨度,证实四至三分层。
在图6第14层附近交叉的驱动下,我们用L0-L14进一步测试了DINOv2 VIT-L/14:它超过了半深浅相(L0-L11),深层L15-L23,以及全深度聚变(L0-L23),而最终层CLS只达到20.4% 20.4\%(图7).
这种对比进一步突出了为什么Sec. IV-C中的分层DINO分析对于基于EEG的视觉解码至关重要,而不是常规地采用最终的分层CLS.
这些扫描确立了我们的默认配对: CLIP RN50多蓝 + DINov2 VIT-L/14 (L0–L14).

We ask whether fused retrieval exceeds either teacher alone, which teacher pairings yield fusion gain for EEG-based visual decoding, and how the training objective and fusion architecture should be configured.

blocks.en:
Table V compares DTHA fused retrieval with matched single-teacher CLIP and DINO baselines on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG under the default teachers (Sec. IV-D ).
In Part I, fused Top-1 reaches 92.4% (EEG) and 64.4% (MEG), surpassing CLIP-only by 11.8/12.3 pp and DINO-only by 3.7/7.7 pp.
In Part II, branch retrieval with S clip S^{\mathrm{clip}} or S dino S^{\mathrm{dino}} alone under joint DTHA training already beats the matching Part I single-teacher run (EEG: + 0.6 +0.6 / + 0.3 +0.3 pp; MEG: + 1.8 +1.8 / + 1.1 +1.1 pp), reflecting co-training synergy under complementary supervision.
The Part I fused score further exceeds both Part II branch retrievals on EEG and MEG, confirming fusion gain beyond either the semantic or appearance-related branch alone and indicating that learned similarity-level fusion complementarily combines both supervision axes.

blocks.en: IV-E 2 Cross-Paradigm Teacher Pairings
blocks.zh: IV-E 2 跨Paradigm 教师配对

blocks.en:
Table IV compares representative teacher pairings under full DTHA on THINGS-EEG.
Cross-paradigm CLIP+DINO rows (1–2) yield positive Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} throughout; row 2 is notable—with weak DINOv3 L0–11 (78.0% single-teacher Top-1), fused retrieval still reaches 89.0% ( Δ gain = + 8.0 \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}}{=}{+}8.0 pp), validating complementary fusion even when one branch is individually weak.
Rows 3–5 show poor fusion performance when PE-Core underperforms on the semantic branch ( Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} from − 4.8 -4.8 to + 0.4 +0.4 pp; Δ br \Delta_{\mathrm{br}} up to 29.5), as a collapsed image–text teacher cannot sustain reliable cross-paradigm supervision.
Same-paradigm stacking also underperforms: row 6 (DINOv3+DINOv2 shallow) yields Δ gain = − 1.0 \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}}{=}{-}1.0 pp, and row 10 (DINOv2 L0–11 plus L12–23) reaches only + 0.1 +0.1 pp without sufficient complementarity.
Rows 7–9 yield positive Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} yet reach only 79.6–83.8% fused Top-1 (vs. 92.6% in row 1), because deep DINO layers—whether paired with CLIP (rows 8–9) or with each other (row 7)—encode appearance-related structure less aligned with decodable scalp EEG than shallow spans (Sec. IV-C ).
Together, these ablations indicate that effective fusion depends on cross-paradigm semantic and appearance-related supervision—multi-blur CLIP with shallow DINO—that better captures the hierarchical visual information embedded in EEG signals, rather than redundant or misaligned multi-teacher stacking.

blocks.en: IV-E 3 Fusion and Training Ablations
blocks.zh: IV-E 3 合并和培训

blocks.en:
Table VI ablates DTHA training objectives and fusion architectures under the default CLIP+DINOv2 recipe on THINGS-EEG.
Table VI (a)i ablates branch and fused-retrieval losses.
Disabling either branch SCE loss lowers Top-1 by 2.5 pp or 1.1 pp, indicating that semantic and appearance-related supervision must both remain active. Fused-retrieval-only training ( 0 : 0 : 1 0{:}0{:}1 ) performs substantially worse (88.8%, − 3.8 -3.8 pp): learning both teachers jointly through S fused S_{\mathrm{fused}} alone deprives each branch of sufficient paradigm-specific supervision.
With all three losses enabled (default 1 : 1 : 0.25 1{:}1{:}0.25 ), branch SCE separately supervises paradigm-specific visual cues through S clip S^{\mathrm{clip}} and S dino S^{\mathrm{dino}} , while the fused-retrieval term learns similarity-level fusion weights that combine them complementarily.
We omit γ = 0 \gamma{=}0 because fusion weights are not learned, inconsistent with our test-time protocol.
Table VI (a)ii shows that the fused-retrieval weight γ \gamma must remain balanced: γ = 0.1 \gamma{=}0.1 under-supervises fusion-weight learning ( − 0.4 -0.4 pp), whereas γ = 1.0 \gamma{=}1.0 over-emphasizes the fused-retrieval loss relative to branch SCE, trending toward fused-retrieval-only optimization ( − 0.4 -0.4 pp); default γ = 0.25 \gamma{=}0.25 is most stable.
Table VI (b) ablates the EEG–image fusion architecture.
A shared encoder with similarity-level fusion is critical: dual EEG encoders incur a modest 0.6 pp drop, possibly from weakened co-training synergy on one shared EEG embedding, while dual projection heads ( − 14.8 -14.8 pp) and feature-level fusion ( ∼ 15 % {\sim}15\% Top-1) substantially impair or collapse retrieval.

blocks.en: We validate the effectiveness of AMSPBE by comparing it with established EEG encoders, ablating its core components, and analyzing the learned tri-region temporal attention curves and scalp-pattern topographies.

As shown in Table VII , our proposed encoder consistently outperforms both classic and recent methods on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG.

Table VIII ablates AMSPBE components.
Ablating either main component still leaves a functional encoder with substantial retrieval performance—70.8% Top-1 without the K = 16 K{=}16 scalp-pattern filter bank, and 92.1% without TSAM and depthwise temporal convolution—while the full model reaches 92.6%, showing that both components contribute and work best together.
Under the default DINOv2 recipe, TSAM and depthwise temporal convolution yield only modest Top-1 gains (+0.6/+0.7 pp), yet their main role is physiologically interpretable tri-region temporal dynamics (Fig. 8 (A–B)).

blocks.en: IV-F 3 Learned Temporal Attention and Scalp Patterns

blocks.en:
Given the interpretability role of TSAM discussed above, we visualize the learned tri-region temporal attention curves and scalp-pattern topographies in Fig. 8 (A–D).
The visualization reveals that AMSPBE automatically assigns higher weights to physiologically meaningful time points rather than arbitrary samples along the RSVP window.
On THINGS-EEG (Fig. 8 (A), 10-subject mean), the posterior partition shows the strongest peaks (e.g., ∼ 76 {\sim}76 ms), with earliest emphasis near ∼ 50 {\sim}50 ms after onset—consistent with the latency of the initial feedforward sweep to primary visual cortex [ 40 ] .
Across partitions, a clear posterior-to-anterior lag matches hierarchical propagation along the occipito-frontal pathway [ 8 , 41 ] : occipital responses rise first, followed by central and frontal contributions.
On THINGS-MEG (Fig. 8 (B), 4-subject mean), the posterior partition often exhibits a pronounced double peak, including a late component around ∼ 605 {\sim}605 ms; the clearer early–late separation plausibly reflects MEG’s longer stimulus duration ( 500 500 ms) and SOA ( 1500 ± 200 1500{\pm}200 ms), which attenuate RSVP-style temporal aliasing relative to THINGS-EEG ( 100 100 ms on, 100 100 ms off).
Fig. 8 (C) displays the sixteen learned scalp-pattern topographies of the K = 16 K{=}16 filter bank for a representative subject (Sub01), each corresponding to a distinct spatial filtering pattern over the electrode montage.
Fig. 8 (D) averages these topographies across ten subjects: occipital channels dominate, and beyond the occipito-parietal cluster (O/PO/P), a secondary hotspot over right prefrontal and frontopolar sites (Fp2, AF4/AF8, F4/F6, FC2/FC4) indicates that several patterns jointly leverage frontal and posterior visual channels.

Under regional partitioning, Table IX further evaluates two additional groupings—posterior V17 (17 P/PO/O channels) vs. non-posterior NV46—beyond the five standard partitions in Fig. 8 (E), reporting per-branch and fused DTHA retrieval.
Decoding is highest in posterior regions (occipital and V17), where the DINO branch clearly outperforms CLIP (e.g., V17: 87.1 % 87.1\% vs. 78.4 % 78.4\% ; fused 90.9 % 90.9\% ), consistent with appearance-related dominance in these channels.

blocks.en: IV-H Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-H 定性分析

blocks.en:
Having established DTHA’s effectiveness through the quantitative results above, we further dissect the mechanisms underlying complementarity-driven DTHA through qualitative analysis on THINGS-EEG.
Following [ 4 ] , the 200 200 test concepts are grouped into five superordinate categories (animal, food, vehicle, tool, and others).
On this grouping, we perform category-structured cross-modal RSA on the test set, followed by retrieval case analysis on representative test queries.
blocks.zh:
在通过上述量化结果确定了DTHA的有效性之后,我们通过对物质-EEG的质量分析,进一步解析了互补驱动的DTHA的基础机制。
继[4]后,200个测试概念被归为5个上位类(动物,食物,车辆,工具等).
在这个分组上,我们在测试集上进行分类结构的跨模式RSA,然后在代表性测试查询上进行检索案例分析.

blocks.en: IV-H 1 Cross-Modal Representational Similarity
blocks.zh: IV-H 1 跨摩多尔省代表性相似性

blocks.en:
Fig. 10 shows cross-modal representational similarity matrices (RSMs) on the THINGS-EEG test set (10-subject mean) under CLIP and DINO single-teacher alignment, alongside DTHA fused retrieval.
CLIP single-teacher alignment exhibits strong intra-category aggregation (bright diagonal blocks; Δ = 0.084 \Delta{=}0.084 ), confirming category-level semantic structure, together with nuanced off-diagonal inter-class similarity as expected under multi-blur supervision.
DINO single-teacher alignment shows a weaker category diagonal ( Δ = 0.065 \Delta{=}0.065 ) but notable off-diagonal inter-class similarity, indicating appearance-related structure beyond superordinate category labels.
DTHA fused retrieval yields a softer category diagonal ( Δ = 0.061 \Delta{=}0.061 ) yet the strongest Top-1 accuracy (Table II ), indicating that retrieval accuracy is not explained by sharper within-category similarity alone, but by a hybrid of category-level semantics and appearance-related visual cues.

CLIP 单师对齐显示强烈的类内集合(Bright diagonal blocks; Δ = 0.084\ Delta{=}0.084),确认类别层次的语义结构,并有细微的离对角类间相似性,与多块监督下的预期相似.
DINO单师对齐显示较弱的类别对角(QQ = 0.065\Delta = 0.065),但显著的离对角同级相近,表示外观相关结构超越了上等类别标签.
DTHA被引信取回产生更软的类对角(QQ = 0.061\Delta = 0.061),但最强的Top-1精度(表二),表明取回精度并非仅由类内较尖锐的相似性来解释,而是由类内语义和外观相关视觉提示的混合.

blocks.en: IV-H 2 Retrieval Case Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-H 2 检索案例分析

blocks.en:
To provide an intuitive illustration of fused retrieval, we analyze representative retrieval cases on test queries.
As shown in Fig. 11 , fused retrieval recovers the correct target at Top-1, while the remaining Top-5 slots mix superordinate-consistent and appearance-related neighbors.
Together, these results indicate that retrieval engages both semantic and appearance-related cues.
Fig. 9 contrasts CLIP-branch, DINO-branch, and fused Top-1 retrieval on four representative queries.
Rows 1–2 (aircraft carrier, SUV): both branches miss the target while fusion recovers the correct image—clear fusion-gain cases when neither teacher alone succeeds.
Row 3 (banana): the CLIP branch fails but the DINO branch retrieves correctly; fusion follows the successful branch and also hits the target.
Row 4 (cupcake): the DINO branch succeeds yet fusion fails when branch rankings conflict—the fused score favors a CLIP-branch semantic distractor over the DINO-correct target, illustrating an occasional conflict case under similarity-level fusion despite overall complementary gains (Table II ).
Collectively, cross-paradigm dual-teacher supervision provides complementary visual cues, supporting more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from EEG and thereby improving retrieval accuracy.

blocks.en: V Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
Motivated by a mechanism–paradigm correspondence between hierarchical visual processing and VFMs trained under distinct paradigms, we proposed DTHA , a cross-paradigm complementarity-driven dual-teacher framework that aligns EEG to complementary semantic (multi-blur CLIP) and appearance-related (shallow DINOv2) teachers through dual-branch supervision and similarity-level fused retrieval.
We further introduced AMSPBE , which pairs strong decoding with interpretable tri-region temporal dynamics and scalp-pattern topographies.
blocks.zh:
基于一种机制的动机—— 等级视觉处理和在不同范式下培训的VFM之间的参数对应,我们提出了DTHA,一种跨参数互补驱动的双教师框架,通过双分支监管和类似级别的引信检索,将EEG与互补语义(多蓝CLIP)和外观相关(shallow DINov2)的教师联系起来。
我们进一步引入了AMPBE,它与可解释的三区时间动态和头皮地形图配有强大的解码。

blocks.en:
On THINGS-EEG zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, surpassing the previous state-of-the-art by 12.4 percentage points.
Teacher-representation analyses, pairing ablations, and fusion-training studies showed that fusion gain arises from cross-paradigm complementarity rather than arbitrary multi-teacher stacking, while qualitative cases indicated hybrid decoding that jointly reflects semantic and appearance-related cues.
Spatial, spectral, and partition-wise analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, further supported biological plausibility and cross-modality generalization.
blocks.zh:
在 things- EEG 零射入 EEG 图像检索上, DTHA 实现 92.4%的Top-1精度,超过之前的先进水平12.4%.
教师代表分析、配对和聚变培训研究显示,聚变增益来自跨参数互补,而不是任意的多教师堆放,而定性案例表明混合解码共同反映了语义和外观相关提示。
空间、光谱和分相分析,以及MOTIS-MEG评价,进一步支持了生物学的可信性和跨模式通论。

blocks.en:
One limitation of this work is that inter-subject retrieval remains far below intra-subject performance.
Most existing EEG visual decoding methods have not specifically targeted the cross-subject generalization challenge, which remains an important direction for our future work.
blocks.zh:
这项工作的一个局限性是,主体之间的检索仍然远远低于主体内部的业绩。
大多数现有的EEG视觉解码方法并没有专门针对跨主题的概括化挑战,这仍然是我们未来工作的一个重要方向.

blocks.en: In summary, this work shows that complementary supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity, improving both zero-shot retrieval accuracy and interpretability of EEG visual decoding.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,本作表明从跨参数VFMs中进行互补的监管,可以更完整地从大脑活性中提取分级视觉信息,提高EEG视觉解码的零发取精度和可解释性.
